Follows a chain of redirects (301 -> 302 -> 200)

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.crawl(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.finalUrl())
debugPrint(result.redirectCount())
```
